steps: float32 WAV, native rate kept (44.1/48 kHz); engine resamples to its rate on load (§4.1)
DC: mean removal + 2nd-order Butterworth HPF 10 Hz zero-phase; final windowed-mean pass (§4.2)
lead trim: -54 dB re peak, never below -60 dBFS post-gain; 1 ms pre-roll, 0.5 ms raised-cosine fade-in (§4.3)
tail trim below -60 dBFS at the normalised level, then 12 ms half-Hann fade-out; fade lengthened (24-192 ms) only where the file ends hot and 12 ms cannot make the last 10 ms <= -60 dBFS (§4.4)
gain: BS.1770 integrated (gated, pyloudnorm) -> -24 LUFS; whole-file measure for files < 400 ms; true-peak cap -6 dBTP (4x), 0.1 dB margin (§4.5)
mono stays mono; bit-identical dual-mono stereo stored as mono (lossless)
prep.positions: every start/loop/granular/slice value in presets_samples.json and PRESET_SPEC §2.1/§9.8 addresses the prepped file
prep.engineNote: the engine still runs §4 on load; on these files it is a no-op within 0.05 LU (gain ~0 dB, trims ~0)
